notes.title: Update Notes - September 30
notes.content:
Content:
- Now with full Xbox controller support! Share your feedback in the community tab.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the issue that prevented new difficulty levels from being unlocked.

notes.title: Update Notes - September 9th
notes.content:
New:
- Improvements to Quests sound feedback.

- Forge Rework: After listening to community feedback, we identified that the Forge wasn't contributing significantly to game progression. The risk of losing a weapon with a favorite skill made the Forge less appealing. To address this, we've completely reworked it and introduced two new modes:

Upgrade Mode: You can now increase the level of a weapon without losing its current skill. Choose the weapon you want to upgrade and select two other weapons of the same tier to complete the upgrade process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43582925/cd548d6043447e54c362cb5df2f5f1a92a98a400.gif[/img]

Skill Mode: It is now possible to swap a weapon’s skill. Simply select the weapon you want to modify and another weapon of the same type with the desired skill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43582925/013327473e20775d23eb0611e20c042a2cfdd1f6.gif[/img]

Thor's Gift: The functionality remains unchanged, but it now features visual feedback effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43582925/aebb2eb0bebda364f3161a9fe88a2657b73bc0a9.gif[/img]

Removal of materials and pet eggs: With the Forge rework, pet eggs and crafting materials are no longer necessary. If you still have any in your inventory, you can sell them. Pets will be obtained as rewards from raids.

notes.title: Update Notes - August 23rd
notes.content:
New:
- NEW BOSS, Sleipnir! Watch out for the surprise he has for you.
- Adventure Experience, now you can check your XP earned during the run in the village and in the main menu.
- Visual feedback in the quest system.
- Localization and font appearance improvements to enhance understanding.

Bugs:
- Fixed the issue with the Golden Apple that caused save data loss.
- Fixed the crash with the Wolf pet that occurred when starting a battle.

notes.title: Get Raiders of Valhalla at a discount and let’s celebrate pixel art games! ⚔️
notes.content:
We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉

We’re super excited to share that Raiders of Valhalla joins PixElated Festival this week! 
This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!
There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos ✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

notes.title: New Viking roguelike blends XCOM and TFT, and it's out now on Steam
notes.content:
Steam is home to a lot of excellent Viking games. Between the polygonal survival of Valheim, dense playspaces of Assassin's Creed Valhalla, and the combat-heavy leanings of God of War, we're spoilt for choice. Raiders of Valhalla is different, though. With the unit management and stakes of XCOM, autobattler tendencies of Teamfight Tactics, and nail-biting choices of the best roguelikes, this party-based RPG is on Valve's platform right now. There's even a demo you can take for a spin, and I've been having a blast.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Halloween of Valhalla
notes.content:
👻 Restless souls and the darkest night draw near! Valhalla has never been so chilling.

🔥 In honor of ancient spirits, we summon all fearless artists: come forth, display your skills, and envision our fearless dwarf in their most astonishing Halloween attire!

How to Challenge the Gods and Participate:
🎃 Design a supernatural and unique costume for our dwarf model.
🎃 Post your masterpiece in the #🎨 |fanarts-arts channel on our Magic Forge (Discord): https://discord.gg/q6syhJ869R
🎃 Final brushstrokes must be applied by midnight on 10/31.

Treasures of the Shadows: 🏆
The fortunate conjurer of the best costume will be gifted with the "Spooky Collection," a mysterious selection of spine-tingling games chosen especially by the Gods of Valhalla.

The Battle of Souls: 🦇
From [b]11/01 until dawn on 11/02 (12:00 hrs GMT-3)[/b], costumes will face mortal judgment in duels on our Grimoire's stories (Instagram). May the most horrifying prevail!

Stars' Revelation: 🌌
The winds of destiny will blow the revelation. Join our Instagram live on 11/02 at 6:00 pm (GMT-3) to discover who has won the favor of the Gods.

🔮 May dark visions inspire your creative minds. We eagerly await your conjurations! 🧛‍♂️ Good luck, brave artists of Valhalla!
